dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Hi. How would you like to go on an adventure?

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: If you like surviving in the wild, deep-water diving, and gliding at breakneck speed, then the Adventurers' Guild needs YOU!

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: I'm a recruiter from the Adventurers' Guild!

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: I'm on the lookout for budding new adventurers who meet the aforementioned criteria.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: ...Oh, and you can also join if you're into exploration, mountain-climbing, things like that.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Does the Adventurers' Guild do those?

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Of course! Clue's in the name, specifically the 'adventure' part.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Hehe, c'mon, don't look so skeptical. I'm actually an expert in adventuring, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: ...Because I've read every last book on the topic from the Wanwen Bookhouse. I know my stuff!

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: I thought adventurers just did commissions?

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Commissions? ...Oh, I know — you mean rich people who want the experience of going on an adventure, but also have safety concerns, so they hire us to take them on survival trips in the wild. Right?

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Trust me, all I need is my trusty knife and I can survive in any environment you put me in!

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: If you join the Adventurers' Guild, I promise you will become an expert just like me in no time! Then you can take all the commissions you want!

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: C'mon, you should join! You'll have a blast!
